stories.story_fr: Le systeme d'exploitation Ignite, deploye a l'echelle de l'entreprise, est cite comme moteur direct de l'expansion de marge operationnelle non-GAAP de 130 points de base sur un an au T2 2026.
stories.story_en: The enterprise-wide Ignite Operating System is cited as a direct driver of the 130 basis-point year-over-year non-GAAP operating margin expansion in Q2 2026.
stories.signal: Levier operationnel maison qui amplifie la marge
stories.quote: non-GAAP operating margin expanded by 130 basis points year-over-year and 180 basis points sequentially ... supported by ... the increasing impact of Ignite Operating System across the organization

stories.story_fr: Le lancement de la nouvelle plateforme 9500 ICP-MS illustre la cadence d'innovation produit qu'Agilent positionne comme moteur de croissance long terme et de productivite laboratoire.
stories.story_en: The launch of the new 9500 ICP-MS platform showcases the product-innovation cadence Agilent positions as a long-term growth and lab-productivity driver.
stories.quote: The introduction of solutions such as our new 9500 ICP-MS platform demonstrates our ability to anticipate evolving customer needs and translate those insights into differentiated technologies that improve laboratory productivity and performance.

stories.story_fr: Agilent attribue son elan a la dynamique du cycle de remplacement d'instruments et a un fort engagement dans les Enterprise Services, signe d'une demande sous-jacente saine au T1 2026.
stories.story_en: Agilent attributes its momentum to instrument-replacement cycle dynamics and strong Enterprise Services engagement, signaling healthy underlying demand in Q1 2026.
stories.signal: Demande de renouvellement de parc installe
stories.quote: The continued momentum in our instrument-replacement cycle, strong engagement in Enterprise Services, and innovation across our portfolio reflect the strength of our customer focused strategy.

stories.story_fr: Le segment Sciences de la vie et Diagnostics affiche une croissance core de 9% au T2 2026, son plus haut rythme recent, portant la croissance core totale du groupe a 6.3%.
stories.story_en: The Life Sciences and Diagnostics segment posted 9% core growth in Q2 2026, its strongest recent pace, lifting total group core growth to 6.3%.
stories.signal: Acceleration du segment le plus strategique
stories.quote: The Life Sciences and Diagnostics Markets Group (LDG) reported second-quarter revenue of $732 million, growth of 12% reported and 9% core year-over-year.
